name: standing-barbell-twist.html
instructions:
1. Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart. Grip the barbell with both hands, palms facing down, and hold it at shoulder height. The bar should rest lightly on the back of your shoulders.
2. Keep your core engaged to protect your lower back and maintain stability. This is the starting position.
3. Slowly rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips facing forward. Keep your arms extended and the barbell steady on your shoulders.
4. Rotate back to the starting position (center) and then rotate to the opposite side in the same controlled manner. This is one rep.
5. Perform the desired number of repetitions, ensuring you maintain controlled movements throughout.
